package.name: san_sim_gazebo_helpers
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Gazebo simulation helper nodes (C++).
PATCH 2026-05-13 (Gazebo deep-dive review): Adds the helpers the existing san_sim_gazebo package was missing: * drone_target_simulator — spawns FPV-style drone targets so the perception → fire_authorization → effector pipeline (KPP-2 ≤ 300ms) is actually testable end-to-end. Previous sim had only static obstacles. * gps_jump_injector — disturbs /robot_N/gps/fix with jumps, drift, noise, and dropout windows. Tests the Limon dual-EKF patches (ekf_local + ekf_global isolation) that we just delivered. Without this, the EKF resilience claim is untested.
Both nodes follow the Tier 1 C++ / rclcpp pattern (DCN-2026-002 D-007) and split pure-logic (gtest) from rclcpp wiring.
Internal modules: * drone_trajectory.{hpp,cpp} — 4 trajectory kinds, pure logic * gps_disturbance.{hpp,cpp} — jump/drift/noise/dropout engine * drone_target_simulator_node — rclcpp Node wrapper + scenarios * gps_jump_injector_node — rclcpp Node wrapper
Executables: drone_target_simulator — ros2 run san_sim_gazebo_helpers ... gps_jump_injector
